title: Actor wake outbox body drift on CreatedAt: pending wakes falsely CAS-fail as concurrent state changes
invariant: A pending actor wake must not be rejected as concurrent state drift on bookkeeping fields that change across a store round-trip.
symptom: Lifecycle transitions on objects with pending wakes CAS-fail with ErrConcurrentStateChange because re-minted wake bodies differ only by a DATETIME-rounded created_at, live-locking the desk.
root_cause: The wake body byte-compare includes created_at copied from the source object, which the Dolt DATETIME column rounds on storage.

title: actorruntime parked-handler tests flake under -race — unbound Texture owner deferral loop
invariant: A parked run's retried lifecycle handler must reactivate or terminalize deterministically regardless of Texture owner binding timing.
symptom: Under -race, parked-handler tests intermittently fail with Texture owner not bound deferrals followed by a lifecycle invalid transition on passivation.
root_cause: unknown

title: Agentic-consensus panel anchors rot silently; OMP fuzzy-matches model ids
invariant: A consensus panel member must report the model that actually served its turn, and an unrecognized panel id must fail closed.
symptom: Panel reported degraded results while four pinned models were dead and one silently served a different model, and unknown --include ids shrank the panel with exit 0.
root_cause: Nothing binds a pinned model id to the served model identity, and panel selection drops unrecognized ids without failing.

title: run start 502 — computer realization flaps unavailable during OOM windows
invariant: Run submissions for a computer in a bounded realization transition must retry or report a transient realizing state rather than fail as unavailable.
symptom: run start returns 502 failed to resolve user autoputer while the guest is internally alive and computing.
root_cause: unknown

title: App-layer release push health gate is not commit-bound — a rolled-back apply reports "healthy"
invariant: A release push must count a computer healthy only when its reported build commit equals the deployed commit.
symptom: Deploy reported 2/2 healthy while a canary computer had rolled back to the prior release after a 503 health-probe refusal.
root_cause: The healthy gate counts HTTP 200 without checking build.commit, and the apply health fence is shorter than replay boot time on large-history computers.
enforcer: .github/workflows/ci.yml app-layer push gate; HTTPHealthProber in choir-updater

title: Candidate Realizations Never Reach Readiness and Are Killed Every 180 Seconds
invariant: An established computer's credential and event-head receipts must verify against the current signer after genesis, or its realization must not reach readiness.
symptom: Candidate realizations boot, start the runtime, fail readiness, and are SIGKILLed by vmctl about every 180 seconds.
root_cause: The bootstrap-only control key resolver refuses its fallback after genesis with no control_key_history row for the platform signer, blocking credential exchange and guest event-authority reconstruction.

title: Effects-Red: Capsule Go-Eval Wiring Has Critical Authority and Evidence Gaps
invariant: A capsule worker's package allowlist must be broker-owned and bound to the activation, so model-authored code cannot widen its own authority.
symptom: Model-supplied allowed_packages and an unbound worker lifetime let model-authored Go bypass broker verbs and outlive activation cancellation.
root_cause: Authority for allowlist, cancellation and obligation revalidation was delegated to model-controlled arguments and unbound worker contexts rather than broker-owned state.

title: Capsule subject artifacts live on tmpfs — `capsule-subject:` refs die with every realization
invariant: A durable artifact ref may be committed only when its bytes live in storage that survives VM realization.
symptom: Verification opener fails with capsule candidate artifact unavailable after hibernate and resume because subject bytes were on tmpfs.
root_cause: Durable refs to capsule subject bytes point into /run tmpfs via CHOIR_CAPSULE_STATE_DIR, which is cleared on every fresh realization.

title: Capsule Teardown: ForceDestroy Strands on Non-Empty Cgroup
invariant: Capsule destruction must kill and drain the capsule cgroup before deletion so no process tree, cgroup or mount leaks past assignment completion.
symptom: Capsule revoke stalls at revoke_requested with cgroup EBUSY still contains running tasks, leaking the capsule cgroup, process tree and overlay mount until restart.
root_cause: Executor.destroy SIGKILLs only the main process and deletes the cgroup without cgroup.kill or waiting for the cgroup to empty.

title: Deploy Critical Path Serialization and Ungated CI Lanes
invariant: Deploy activation must stay gated on check success while the pure Nix build runs ahead, and only deployable paths may trigger host or guest deploys.
symptom: Docs-only and script-only commits ran full deploys with a 751s closure build, and docs-only pushes ran ungated runtime test shards.
root_cause: The deploy Nix build is serialized after check, the classifier catch-all sends unknown scripts to full deploy, and go-test-runtime lacks the go plan gate.

title: CI: a docs-only head push after a failed runtime deploy strands the runtime code undeployed
invariant: Staging deploy decisions must diff the deployed commit against main head, not only the latest push delta.
symptom: Docs-only pushes after a failed runtime deploy left staging one runtime commit behind with no deploy scheduled.
root_cause: The deploy gate keys on non_docs computed from the push delta, so deploy-impact never runs when the latest push is docs-only.

title: Duplicate Race Horn and Serialized SBOM Critical Path
invariant: A selected Race run must substitute -race for the ordinary test population once, and only a finalizer after successful check may publish an accepted SBOM.
symptom: Selected-Race runs execute two Go test horns and run differential SBOM after check, extending a run to about 30 minutes.
root_cause: Race selection is not derived once, the Race route duplicates the ordinary horn, and SBOM generation is serialized after the check gate.

title: CI flake: pre-bind research-recovery delivery row intermittently absent
invariant: Post-terminalization lifecycle control delivery must be observable through a durable receipt rather than a transient bound claim.
symptom: A pre-bind recovery test read an empty delivered-to-run row in about 80% of runs because the transient claim was already released at run terminalization.
root_cause: A stale post-S0m assertion read the transient DeliveredToRunID claim, racing the intentional stranded-bound release.

title: Go CI cache starvation and duplicate discovery compilation
invariant: CI cache keys must bind to workload and source revision so a stale restored cache can never stop heavy lanes from publishing compiled work.
symptom: Runtime race shards spent minutes recompiling because a restored August cache entry was hit and no cache was saved.
root_cause: The cache key includes Go version and go.sum but not source revision, build mode or workload, and discovery compiles in a different mode with swallowed errors.

title: Scope-Disjoint CI Entrypoint Is Rejected by the Doc Truth Checker
invariant: The doc truth checker's entrypoint validation must match the declared mission-graph authority topology, admitting one product root plus bounded scope-disjoint maintenance entries.
symptom: Strict live doccheck fails with expected exactly one mission graph entrypoint, found 2, despite a valid registry.
root_cause: cmd/doccheck enforces a total-one-entrypoint rule that predates the scope-disjoint maintenance exception added to the graph and manifest.

title: First-Party SBOM Cache Is Exact-Derivation, Not Differential
invariant: An accepted SBOM must stay bound to the current package derivation, and unchanged dependency inventories may be reused only after root identity rebinding.
symptom: Ten first-party SBOMs were rebuilt on every selected commit even when their dependency additions and removals were empty.
root_cause: Reuse keys on the full sbom derivation path, which embeds buildCommit and buildDate and so changes on every commit.

title: CI SBOM Nested-Nix Sandbox Failure
invariant: Runtime SBOM generation must run outside the package's Nix build sandbox so nested nix invocations cannot fail every package.
symptom: All twelve package SBOM derivations failed with a Nix profile directory permission error, producing no usable baseline.
root_cause: sbomnix invokes nix build inside the outer runCommand derivation, a nested Nix call that cannot initialize the profile path.

title: CI Test Flake: Unbounded Provider-Channel Waits Race the Activation Deadline
invariant: Test waits on provider-controlled channels must be bounded so a run terminalized before Execute cannot hang the suite.
symptom: A race-shard test hung for the full 10-minute go test timeout, blocked on an unbounded receive from the provider started channel.
root_cause: The test over-specified the interleaving by requiring Execute to start after the activation progress deadline may already have terminalized the run.

title: Clustering Assessment — Engineering Assignment / Selfdev Op Wedge Class
invariant: Every non-terminal obligation row must have a live driver or pending reconcile trigger, and every retry path must re-arm rather than die after one error.
symptom: Selfdev operations and engineering assignments sat in non-terminal states indefinitely because reconcile triggers never fired or a one-shot retry died after one error.
root_cause: Reconciliation is event-triggered only, with missing trigger edges into recovery authorities and one-shot retry drains, so non-terminal rows never recover.

title: coagent_result consumed without reactivating the parked run — deliverable-strand class
invariant: A bound coagent_result obligation must reactivate its parked run from the obligation's bound run identity, not only from the actor snapshot's resume pointer.
symptom: A researcher run stayed passivated across guest boots while its coagent_result obligation remained open, with no reactivation logged.
root_cause: Leading candidate, unconfirmed: the actor snapshot lost resume.RunID, so both the live dispatch and the boot hedge depend on the missing pointer.

title: Continuous Texture Supervision — Implementation Inventory
invariant: Each durable lifecycle work item, control, and provider activation must have one exact authority, so wake, delivery, and retry paths cannot loop, starve, or exceed one authorized chain.
symptom: Staging Texture supervision repeatedly failed: initial work never activated, Researcher bind and mailbox loops ran, and a retained terminal Texture state crashed computer boot.
root_cause: Multiple causes recorded: a duplicate one-shot dispatch was treated as reactivation authority, open work as unlimited provider authority, and caller binding metadata as ownership.
enforcer: lifecycle reducer ApplyTextureTurn (Store-side validator); proxy shared API-key computer guard

title: Deploy refresh verifier rejects pointer-following guests on a new deploy
invariant: A deploy's post-refresh identity check must accept each valid guest identity class, retained release or deployed pointer commit, and fail closed on anything else.
symptom: Deploy run 37414528508 reported failure although services and the refreshed guest were healthy on the new commit, because the verifier waited for the pre-refresh commit.
root_cause: CI derived the post-refresh expected commit from the guest's pre-refresh served commit, which is wrong for guests that follow the host autoputer pointer.

title: Doc Authority Witness and Heresy-Precision Drift
invariant: Documentation witnesses must name live code packages, and heresy term matching must use word boundaries so governance checks track the actual codebase.
symptom: Doccheck emitted stale witness warnings for the dissolved internal/runtime package and false H1 hits on substrings such as releases and split-line continuation-level.
root_cause: The actor-runtime cutover deleted internal/runtime without updating manifest witnesses, and scanHeresyTerms used strings.Contains instead of word-boundary matching.

title: Document-Cast Settlement: Freeze-Before-Validate Strands the Assignment
invariant: A capsule freeze must not occur before the authority checks that make it terminal-safe, and every frozen or bound assignment must have a bounded path to terminal disposition.
symptom: A document-channel engineering assignment stayed bound with an active capsule for about five hours after its run completed, with no report or completion events.
root_cause: Freeze ran the executor effect before selfdev and authority validation, the overlay mandated choir.Freeze for document casts, and no watchdog or periodic sweep cancelled the strand.

title: Document-Cast Terminal Report Strands After Capsule Revoke
invariant: A terminal assignment completion must either commit its report or be rejected before freeze and revoke side effects, so no saga strands after capsule revocation.
symptom: After capsule revoke, the assignment stayed bound with a revoked capsule and a staged report that could never be recorded, because its verdict was rejected post-revoke.
root_cause: The model passed summary prose as the verdict argument, and Tray.Complete validated result but not verdict, so ValidateAgainst rejected it only after freeze and revoke committed.
enforcer: Tray.Complete in-cell verdict validation and commitCompleteIntent coercion

title: Texture Document Aliases Lack a Reconstructible Replay Authority
invariant: Every durable Texture state a computer restore depends on must be reconstructible from event-derived authority, or whole-computer replay eligibility must stay closed.
symptom: Whole-computer replay reported not_equivalent because the non-empty texture_document_aliases table is written outside event projection and has no computer_id.
root_cause: Owner-keyed alias state has no settled reconstructible authority family, so replay eligibility classifies it as EmptyUntilSupported.

title: Bound engineering run dies silently — assignment stays "usable" forever, op pins executing
invariant: A bound engineering assignment whose run has terminated must be revoked or recast by the fate reconcile, triggered by run termination rather than only at boot or occurrence wake.
symptom: A selfdev operation's bound run stopped logging with no terminal record, leaving the operation executing for over 60 minutes with zero live runs.
root_cause: assignedEngineeringCapsuleUsable checked only capsule liveness, not bound run state, and run terminalization did not enqueue the engineering reconcile.

title: Engineering verification chain dead — canonical ref miss + agent-head gate wedge ops at `frozen`
invariant: Verification owed to a completed implementation must remain openable from its report refs, independent of the head authorship that gated cast admission.
symptom: A completed implementation's selfdev operation stayed at frozen for about 35 minutes with no verification assignment, error, or event.
root_cause: Report refs were resolved by canonical-ID suffix against ReportID, so lookups silently missed, and the reconcile early-returned unless the document head was owner-authored.

title: Fresh-computer prompt-bar submit fails: `invalid genesis` on projection-batch append
invariant: No run or prompt-bar write may be persisted to a computer's canonical event chain before that computer's genesis or bootstrap-chain has been established.
symptom: Every fresh-computer prompt-bar submission returned HTTP 500 with 'invalid genesis' on the projection-batch append.
root_cause: completePromptBarDecisionRun persisted the agent record via UpsertAgent without the pre-genesis admission gate that createRunWithMetadata enforces.
enforcer: internal/agentcore/runtime.go createRunWithMetadata pre-genesis gate (not shared with the prompt-bar path)

title: Genesis Computer Surface: Underivable SPA and Missing Dynamic Chunk Preload
invariant: A computer must not accept routed surface traffic before its immutable frontend baseline is staged and verified, and missing hashed assets must never fall back to HTML.
symptom: On newly provisioned computers a Settings app CSS chunk failed to preload, and reload returned HTTP 503 'served SPA is underivable'.
root_cause: ComputerSurface falls back to index.html for missing /assets files, and an EnsureComputerSurface failure is only logged as deferred so the VM starts without a baseline.

title: Problem: Guest Dolt Journal Leak + Host Dead-Image Accumulation (Owner Computer Wedged)
invariant: Every guest store and host VM image growth path must have a reachable, scheduled bound, so a live-size guard can never permanently suppress the GC that shrinks the journal.
symptom: The owner guest's Dolt noms journal grew to about 22 GiB, the guest wedged under write pressure, and host dead images accumulated with no prune path.
root_cause: MaybeRunDoltGC's live-store guard returns before the journal GC trigger, so GC never runs once live size exceeds 5 GiB; .corrupt and .pre-upgrade images are never matched by any prune.
enforcer: unowned (internal/store/dolt_maintenance.go MaybeRunDoltGC is the intended owner, unfixed)

title: Problem: Guest Release Propagation Is Manual — Owner Directive to Design It
invariant: A guest must adopt a new release only after compatibility preflight and a drain-boundary ordering, and fleet staleness against the deployed commit must be observable.
symptom: Running guests stayed on old builds after platform deploys until a manual refresh, so owner-facing behavior diverged from main.
root_cause: No deploy-to-guest propagation exists; the triggering and ordering discipline for guest refresh is undesigned, so refresh is manual.

title: Guest service stderr is unreachable after cold boot — no serial sink, no journal surface
invariant: Every guest service's stderr and startup diagnostics must remain reachable from the host after cold boot, so in-guest failures are attributable without rebuilding the image.
symptom: Layering wrapper diagnostics never reached a host-visible surface, forcing an image rebuild and redeploy cycle just to read one stderr line.
root_cause: Disposable VMs run with fc-config logger None and no serial sink, and the host journal relay buffers only the cold-boot window, so journal+console output is dropped.

title: Guest VM embedded objectgraph-dolt starved inside 8-GiB interactive shape
invariant: A guest's memory budget must bound the working set of its embedded object-graph store, and that store's growth must be bounded by GC or snapshot pruning.
symptom: run start hung and texture reads failed with context canceled on the interactive guest, which was thrashing at its 8 GiB ceiling.
root_cause: The 8 GiB interactive guest shape cannot host an embedded objectgraph-dolt store above 11 GiB, and the store grows without a GC or snapshot bound.
enforcer: unowned (VM_INTERACTIVE_MEM_MIB=16384 staged in vmctl-priority.env, not yet effective)

title: Held Computer Boot Crash-Loop and Resolve Race: Owner Primary Bound to a Sealed Computer
invariant: Maintenance hold must be a benign held state that never causes a fatal startup crash-loop, and host resolve must complete deterministically for a held computer.
symptom: The owner's staging computer never completed boot in the browser; the guest restarted about every 18 seconds and browser probes aborted at 15 seconds.
root_cause: Texture-owner startup reconcile turned run-admission refusal under the maintenance hold into log.Fatalf, and the browser abort canceled vmctl's pending assignment.

title: Unheld Guest Dies After Super Rewarm During Terminal-Outcome Scan
invariant: Runtime boot recovery must be bounded by owner-scoped indexed work, so no boot phase loads every historical terminal run before the computer reports started.
symptom: The unheld guest died during boot after Super rewarm, before logging runtime started, and probes returned 502 failed to resolve user autoputer.
root_cause: reconcileTerminalRunOutcomes materialized every completed, failed, and cancelled run through unindexed metadata scans at boot on a 4 GiB guest.

title: Unheld Guest Dies in Boot Work-Item Sweep After Super Rewarm
invariant: Boot-time work-item sweeps must read only indexed pending-mailbox rows and never full object-graph snapshots, so boot memory is bounded by the pending set.
symptom: The unheld guest died during sweep_open_work_item_actors on boot after Super rewarm, without logging runtime started.
root_cause: ListPendingLifecycleUpdates called ReadObjectSnapshot of every kind per trajectory, materializing up to 20 full-graph snapshots on a 4 GiB guest.

title: Persistent Data Image Critically Full After Product-Path Recover
invariant: Persistent disk usage reported for a computer must measure guest-visible occupancy against the same quantity as the cap, never host VM-directory allocation.
symptom: After recovery the computer was degraded with 'persistent data image is critically full' while guest ext4 showed about 11 GiB used of 31 GiB.
root_cause: LookupDataImageStats compares allocated blocks of the whole VM state directory against the data.img virtual size, a mismatched measurement.

title: Single Lookup Health-Fail Marks Unheld Computer Degraded After Recover
invariant: An active computer must become degraded only after consecutive health failures outside the routing grace window, never after a single failed lookup probe.
symptom: A computer that booted active and served bootstrap 200s was marked degraded minutes later after one failed lookup health probe, and bootstrap returned 502.
root_cause: vmctl lookup writes VMStateDegraded on a single CheckHealth failure, with no consecutive-failure threshold and no routing grace.

title: Unheld Guest Dies During Super Rewarm ListAllRunsByState(passivated)
invariant: Boot-time persistent-Super rewarm must query passivated runs through an owner-scoped indexed header list, never a full-keyset body scan, so boot cost does not grow with historical runs.
symptom: The unheld guest died during rewarm_persistent_super about 35 seconds after listen, before runtime started or terminal-outcome repair logged.
root_cause: rewarmInterruptedPersistentSuperActors and reactivateRestartedPersistentSuperControlRun each called ListAllRunsByState(passivated), loading every passivated run body at boot.
enforcer: internal/agentcore/runtime.go (owner-scoped passivated Super header list via ListObjectRefsByKindOwner)

title: Unheld Guest Recycles During Persistent-Super Boot Sweep
invariant: Boot-time Super rewarm must skip unrecoverable run tombstones and must not rescan the owner's full run table once per trajectory.
symptom: Guest autoputer process died about 100s after listen during the boot sweep, before runtime start was logged, and systemd restarted it.
root_cause: Persistent Super reconcile ran once per trajectory and aborted the whole Super rewarm on the first ErrLifecycleInvalidTransition from a tombstone run.

title: Unheld Guest Dies on Super Delivered-Control Snapshot
invariant: Boot-time recovery must never materialize the whole owner graph, including run and event bodies, to find a few pending controls.
symptom: Guest died about 25s after listen inside Super rewarm while reading a full owner-computer object snapshot, and host lookup grace then expired.
root_cause: Delivered-control listing read every object body for the owner and computer via ReadObjectSnapshot to locate one pending control.

title: Unheld Guest Dies JSON_EXTRACT-Scanning Worker-Update Bodies During Super Validate
invariant: Recovery validation must resolve pending deliveries through indexed canonical IDs, never by scanning every owner worker-update body per candidate run.
symptom: Guest died about 5 minutes after listen after four sequential owner-wide worker-update body scans during Super validate, before any dispatch.
root_cause: Per-run validation called ListLifecycleControlsDeliveredToRunPage, which JSON_EXTRACTs every owner worker-update body to find one run's packets.

title: Unheld Guest Dies Listing Every Worker-Update Body During Super Rewarm
invariant: Super rewarm must list only the delivered worker-update packets for the one run it validates, and health must not share the Dolt engine with boot scans.
symptom: Guest died about 20s after listen while listing delivered controls for each empty-trajectory Super tombstone, then again during passivate_interrupted_activations.
root_cause: listWorkerUpdateObjects loads every choir.worker_update body for the computer per tombstone without predicating on delivered_to_loop_id.

title: Irreversible Effects Were Mistaken for a Human-Approval Boundary
invariant: Each effect's authorization must come from its predeclared consensus policy, and reversibility alone must never gate autonomous action.
symptom: Authoritative doctrine and code treated reversibility or universal owner approval as the effect boundary, contradicting the settled effect-specific consensus model.
root_cause: An inference, never owner-settled, that reversibility is the autonomy boundary was written into doctrine and implemented as owner-gated code.

title: Problem Receipt: Kernel Cutover Wake Gaps (G1–G11)
invariant: Every canonical transition that creates a continuation obligation must mint a durable wake, while boot restores state without starting in-flight work.
symptom: Kernel pending projection would strand continuations such as open work items, passivated runs, assignments and cancellations once legacy sweeps are deleted at cutover.
root_cause: The outbox derives wakes only from choir.worker_update objects, a trigger set too narrow for many continuation-bearing canonical transitions.

title: Legacy Run Lookup Order Can Exhaust the Store Deadline
invariant: A run lookup must read the most probable exact identity first, so an unnecessary miss cannot consume the store deadline for a valid lookup.
symptom: CancelRunTrajectory on a 1,001-run legacy trajectory failed with object-store context deadline exceeded before cancellation began.
root_cause: getRunForComputer probes the lifecycle canonical ID before the legacy owner-scoped run, and the known-missing probe consumes the deadline at scale.

title: Problem receipt: texture-delivery reconcile CommandID under-specifies identity → runtime startup crash loop
invariant: A lifecycle command's idempotency key must cover every request field its digest covers, so a boot reconcile cannot conflict with its own prior receipt.
symptom: Owner runtime crash-respawned every ~60s on boot with lifecycle command digest conflict during Texture update delivery reconcile.
root_cause: The texture-delivery CommandID was keyed only on the target slot while the digest covered content that drifts across boots, so a changed batch re-presented the same ID with a new digest.

title: M11 candidate-B reject decision fails pin verification
invariant: A decision event's payload pin privacy class must match the event's privacy class, so every decision type can commit through the head CAS.
symptom: Reject decisions on self-development operations returned 400 payload pin mismatch, so the reject event never committed and the operation stayed awaiting_approval.
root_cause: The reject branch appends a private-class output payload to an owner-class decision event, while PinPrivatePayload always pins privacy_class as private.

title: M11 blocker: engineering desk occurrence hot-loops ErrDeferUnprocessed; selfdev operation never advances past `executing`
invariant: An engineering desk wake whose handler fails must be disposed or bounded by attempts, never redelivered indefinitely while its operation stays executing.
symptom: Self-development operations stayed executing while the desk occurrence hot-looped on ErrDeferUnprocessed with the underlying cause hidden from host observability.
root_cause: Stacked causes: a missing files/Source/platform on virgin computers, a capsule ref-prefix mismatch, and a reaper racing the live open saga, each surfacing as a deferred wake.

title: M11 blocker: `choir.Freeze` base-head equality is unsatisfiable on a live tape
invariant: A self-development freeze must refuse only on competing state transitions since its pin, not on any canonical event that advances the head.
symptom: choir.Freeze refused with base head unavailable, stale, or pending on every attempt, leaving the operation pinned executing.
root_cause: freezeCapsuleEffectBundle required CanonicalEventHead to equal the operation BaseHead, which projection batches and the operation's own events always advance.

title: M11 blocker: release secret gate refuses the genuine autoputer binary
invariant: A release refusal predicate must use a scan precise enough for each payload type, so a genuine built artifact cannot be unsatisfiably refused.
symptom: Freeze refused the genuine autoputer binary as containing secret content, making the freeze leg structurally unsatisfiable.
root_cause: The redaction-grade DetectPrivateSecrets detector, built to over-match for redaction, was reused as a refusal predicate on binary payloads and matched linker string blobs.

title: M11 freeze leg: secret-screen false positive + execution-ref prefix mismatch
invariant: Freeze's refusal screen and its execution-reference validator must accept the same reference and payload contracts that the resolver and prompts produce.
symptom: Freeze refused a vendored pdf.js worker as secret content, and bundle validation rejected capsule-go-eval refs that the resolver had accepted.
root_cause: The redaction-grade detector is used as a text refusal predicate, and validExecutionRef accepts only the capsule-exec prefix while resolver and prompts use capsule-go-eval.

title: M11 probe run 2026-09-29: implementation completed with zero subject mutations
invariant: A desk implementation reported completed must produce an observable subject mutation or be refused, never pass verification as a silent no-op.
symptom: Implementation reported completed with zero subject digest change, the operation failed with no candidate artifact, and the probe ended blocked at awaiting_approval.
root_cause: unknown

title: M11 probe route: divergent consensus synthesis
invariant: Acceptance witnesses must drive only owner-reachable API paths, so probe-injected state cannot count as product behavior.
symptom: The probe injected modes and read heads over SSH loopback as cluster root, generating timing races such as a drain-vs-handler 409 that an owner would not produce.
root_cause: The commit-then-finalize window around the decision append lets drain and handler race; the probe's out-of-band setMode polling triggered it.

title: M11 follow-on blocker: restart-recast desk run's terminal report is uncommittable; retries corrupt receipt cardinality
invariant: A retried engineering report commit must be idempotent, so one first-attempt validation failure cannot permanently poison the report's receipt cardinality.
symptom: A restart-recast desk run completed its work, but its terminal report failed every commit attempt and the operation failed with null terminal_error.
root_cause: bindFrozenAssignmentExecutionReceipts mutates the report in place on each retry, so one failed attempt permanently breaks cardinality; the first attestation mismatch is unnamed.

title: M11 blocker: guest restart cancels the bound desk run terminally; the selfdev operation strands `executing` forever
invariant: A restart-cancelled bound desk must either re-cast or terminally fail its operation, never leave the operation executing indefinitely.
symptom: A guest restart mid-desk-run cancelled the assignment terminally, and the selfdev operation stayed executing with no path to resume.
root_cause: A terminal cancelled disposition blocked re-cast because the attempt-1 identity had no path to attempt N+1, and the operation had no transition on bound-assignment cancellation.

title: M11: supervision is blind to desk progress — reports queue durably but never wake a supervisor
invariant: Every committed desk report and every overdue bound assignment must wake its supervising actor without minting new execution authority.
symptom: Desk reports queued durably but never woke Management or Texture, and a stalled desk produced no supervision signal.
root_cause: wakeUpdatedCoagent suppresses producer-report wakes, document-cast return packets target a desk agent that never runs, and no progress deadline existed.

title: M11 blocker: Texture required-write loop starves the engineering desk op
invariant: A wake whose activation fails its required write must be disposed or backed off to a bound, never redelivered at fixed cadence indefinitely.
symptom: A Texture continuation failed the required-write check and was redelivered about every 45s indefinitely, leaving the engineering operation starved at executing.
root_cause: Cell-carrier defects: yaegi cells re-imported choir causing redeclaration failures, update_coagent payloads were inlined into chat, and JSON-bodied verbs demanded serialized strings.

title: M11 blocker: fresh computer boots actuator=tools; engineering desk is handed a choir-less interpreter and cannot ever complete
invariant: An engineering desk's composed overlay and completion guard must be admitted only on a route where its required verbs exist, or be refused at admission.
symptom: Engineering assignments on fresh actuator=tools computers stranded executing after dozens of cells failed with undefined choir.
root_cause: The host composes the choir-requiring engineering overlay and completion guard unconditionally, while a fresh computer's actuator defaults to tools with no choir namespace.

title: Management desk still carries typed JSON tools — RLM cutover incomplete
invariant: Each desk exposes only its in-cell desk_go_eval tool, and semantic acts ride choir.* verbs rather than ad-hoc typed JSON tool calls.
symptom: A report_to_texture JSON tool call was visible on the live staging surface, and management registered extra typed tools beyond the cell.
root_cause: Management's tool registry kept typed JSON tools from the incomplete RLM cutover, duplicating in-cell capability with weaker provenance.

title: Node B deploy disk headroom — deploys blocked below 90 GiB
invariant: Node B root filesystem free space must stay above the deploy preflight floor, reclaimed by store-aware GC rather than manual deletion of live-adjacent artifacts.
symptom: Deploy to Staging repeatedly failed the disk preflight because root free space stayed below the 90 GiB headroom floor across several deploys.
root_cause: Bounded reclaim only touches unprotected active VMs and nix generations, so stale forensic artifacts and growing platform-artifacts/corpus-dolt stores are never reclaimed.

title: Owner revision blocked on engineering-bound documents: supervision subject counts as desk target and steals the revision wake
invariant: An owner revision must wake exactly the document's executor desk and must never be blocked by a non-executing supervision subject.
symptom: texture revise on engineering-bound documents returned HTTP 409 'multiple open desk target work items' on every attempt.
root_cause: The per-document supervision subject was counted as a revision target and chosen as the owner-revision wake target, violating the one-desk-agent-per-document assumption.

title: Stranded passivated run — wake may be consumed before the run drains to it
invariant: A wake bound to a passivated run must remain reconcilable until that run is reactivated or reaches a terminal state.
symptom: A research run passivated at boot never reactivated, and no longer appears in run list, after serial drain disposed its dead-wake rows.
root_cause: unknown (hypothesis only: the wake was consumed as dead while the run was passivated; wake table evidence not yet checked)

title: Clustering assessment: platform-dolt OOM → realization flap → serial-drain starvation
invariant: platform-dolt memory footprint must be bounded so host memory pressure cannot kill the store and retained guest VM and starve wake draining.
symptom: platform-dolt RSS growth led to OOM kills that dropped the guest VM, causing run start 502s and starved wake-outbox drains.
root_cause: platform-dolt memory grows without bound on a fixed-capacity host, per the assessment (measured ~23.7 GiB peak).

title: Platform-update tail: stranded after `applied`, and baseless computers cannot mint checkpoints
invariant: A platform update that reaches materialization_applied must always be resumable to checkpoint publication and route promotion.
symptom: Updates stopped after materialization_applied with no checkpoint or route projection, and fresh computers could not mint checkpoints at all.
root_cause: The post-applied tail has no resume predicate and fresh computers have no advertised replay base, so checkpoint minting is refused.

title: Problem Receipt — Post-Rename Vocabulary Residuals on the Live Surface
invariant: Live-surface desk vocabulary must use canonical names, with legacy tokens confined to the decoder/migration layer.
symptom: Legacy co-super and super vocabulary remains on live tool names, error strings, run metadata, routes and prompts after the rename.
root_cause: The durable vocabulary migration (R5b rename-migrate) was deferred indefinitely, leaving legacy vocabulary load-bearing on the live surface.

title: Replay eligibility stale manifest — `texture_decisions` deleted from DDL, still declared present
invariant: The replay-eligibility manifest must declare only schema objects that exist or are formally retired, so declared-absent objects never refuse checkpoints.
symptom: Self-development checkpoints and nine tests were refused with 'declared schema objects are missing', and materialize tests spun on refusals.
root_cause: Table retirement was half-done: the DDL was deleted but the manifest still declared texture_decisions as ReplayEmptyUntilSupported.

title: Effects-Red: Retained Computer Lifecycle Start Does Not Complete
invariant: A retained computer's lifecycle start must either reach running or fail with an observable terminal state, never hang without response headers.
symptom: Start, restart and refresh on the retained computer left it stopped, with requests timing out or returning 502 and no state change.
root_cause: unknown (the doc records the symptom and names diagnosis as the next action)

title: Root-Cause Cluster: The Wrong-Path Class
invariant: Every effect's continuation must be derivable from the canonical tape, never from process-local timers, wakes, or out-of-band channels.
symptom: Out-of-band continuations and side channels strand work on restart and report run-terminal state while the fate remains non-terminal.
root_cause: Choir has two ways to cause effects, and the non-tape path produces continuations that are not derivable from the tape.

title: S0 finding: deploy's active-VM refresh skips autoputer-internal changes
invariant: A deploy must refresh active guests whenever the guest binary changes, so running guests report the pushed deployed_commit.
symptom: A push to autoputer internals went green while the active owner computer kept running the pre-fix autoputer binary.
root_cause: The deploy-impact classifier does not include autoputer package internals in the active-VM refresh trigger.

title: S0 — vmctl boot-timeline fetch deadlocks the manager lock
invariant: Host VM control locks must never be held across network fetches, exec calls, or unbounded boot waits.
symptom: All VM boots hung in booting and boot-timeline fetches timed out for every computer while health and list endpoints still responded.
root_cause: fetchGuestBootTimeline re-acquires a non-reentrant mutex via mark inside its critical section, and bootVM runs the fetch while holding the manager lock.

title: S0 finding — gateway token passes through the guest kernel command line
invariant: Provider gateway credentials must never appear in world-readable guest kernel command lines or host-readable launch configs.
symptom: The gateway token is appended to Firecracker boot_args, readable via guest /proc/cmdline and persisted in fc-config.json.
root_cause: buildFirecrackerConfig passes the token through boot_args even though a persist-volume token file is already written before launch.

title: S0: artifact-GC `og` live set read Store A — active sweep mass-deleted live corpus bodies
invariant: An artifact sweep may delete a file only when its live set was fully loaded from the store that owns the referencing rows, and fails closed otherwise.
symptom: An active artifact GC sweep deleted 45,829 og files still referenced by corpus rows, and 161,185 live references are now missing from disk.
root_cause: The og live-set query ran against the Store A pool instead of the corpus Store B, and live-set load errors did not abort the sweep.

title: S0 finding: any guest inherits host-internal authority — cross-tenant control-plane reach and a frontend-injection chain
invariant: Host-internal control endpoints must authorize callers by transport-bound identity, never by network position or a self-asserted header.
symptom: Guests could reach host-internal endpoints and forge X-Internal-Caller and X-Authenticated-User to act across tenants, including platform-update minting.
root_cause: Host-internal authority is inferred from VM network position plus a self-asserted header, with unfiltered tap-to-tap and guest-to-internet egress.

title: S0-2: guest serial console + journal unreachable — no host-side capture
invariant: Every guest's serial console output must be captured to a bounded, per-VM, host-readable sink.
symptom: Guest boot output and stderr were unreadable from the host after cold boot, with serial output mixed into the shared vmctl journal.
root_cause: The Firecracker launch path never captured serial output, and cmd.Stdout was wired to the shared os.Stdout.

title: S0 finding: the new internal read surface is protected only by a forgeable header
invariant: Internal read endpoints must authenticate callers by a transport-bound credential, never by a caller-supplied X-Internal-Caller header.
symptom: Guest-reachable boot-timeline and tcp-dial endpoints, and host vmctl boot-timeline, accept any caller that sets X-Internal-Caller: true.
root_cause: guestInternalCaller and the vmctl boot-timeline handler check only a forgeable header value.

title: M9a platform-follow bootstrap binds the route slot's desktop component as a computer ID
invariant: A route slot's owner-plus-desktop identity must resolve to the stable computer ID before any caller tap-binding check compares addresses.
symptom: Fresh platform-update route bootstrap was refused with 403 because vmctl looked up 'primary' as a computer ID, leaving the route slot absent.
root_cause: vmctl's guest binding parses the route slot's second component as a stable computer ID, while the slot schema defines an owner-plus-desktop pair.

title: S0 finding: self-development op sits in `executing` after the model's turn ends — no-op proposals are indistinguishable from a transport wedge
invariant: A self-development operation must reach a terminal or refused state once its worker turn ends, never remaining executing silently.
symptom: Operations sat in executing with empty verifier refs after their eval cells succeeded, and no error was surfaced.
root_cause: armCellTerminalDeadline armed from the model's timeout_ms-wrapped context, so successful cells were durably fated timeout before their commit landed.

title: S0-1: storage lifecycle — the dead-dir reaper can't reap, and platform-artifacts has no GC
invariant: Every storage growth surface must have a reachability-exact, grace-gated reaper that can actually reclaim its orphans.
symptom: Orphan vm-state dirs were never pruned, and platform-artifacts grew to 78G with no garbage collection.
root_cause: PruneRetention authorizes orphans through a route guard that always fails for empty user and desktop IDs, and the file-CAS GC has no non-test callers.

title: S0 finding: guest tap egress and tap-to-tap reachability are unfiltered
invariant: Guest computers must not reach other computers, host control-plane ports, or arbitrary internet endpoints except through an enforced isolation policy.
symptom: A guest reached another guest's autoputer, the host vmctl port, and 1.1.1.1:443 because FORWARD rules accept traffic per tap unconditionally.
root_cause: Unconditional per-tap FORWARD ACCEPT rules in both directions; no isolation policy exists between guests, host control plane, or internet.

title: S0 Problem: Texture boot reconcile crash-loops autoputer on live trajectory with no open texture work
invariant: Boot reconciliation of a Texture subject must agree with the submit path's predicate, so a live trajectory without open work never fails runtime startup.
symptom: The guest autoputer restart-looped every 8-9 minutes because boot reconcile returned errTextureLifecycleOpenWorkUnavailable and refused startup.
root_cause: Reconcile eligibility checked trajectory Live status while submit required an Open work item assigned to the texture agent, so the two predicates disagreed.

title: S0 finding: vocabulary rescan fires whenever a replay applies any rows
invariant: Boot-time vocabulary migration cost must not scale with total event tape length on boots that apply only a few new events.
symptom: A refresh boot applying a handful of rows took 662.7s to healthy versus 9.9s with zero rows, because a full 240k-event vocabulary rescan ran.
root_cause: The replayed predicate uses the replay head sequence (Sequence>0) rather than the count of events applied this boot, so any applied row forces the full rescan.

title: Registration-computer reaches active with no canonical genesis — first write 500s
invariant: A computer must not report active and writable until its canonical event chain has genesis, and a fresh computer must mint genesis before serving.
symptom: A freshly registered computer reported active but its first prompt-bar write returned 500 until a manual bootstrap-chain call minted genesis.
root_cause: materializeProjectionBaseIfNeeded plans RecoveryGenesis without minting, and no boot path calls the genesis mint, so a fresh computer has no canonical head.

title: S0m finding: bound carrier consumes the work but the control packet is never marked incorporated
invariant: A bound control packet must be marked incorporated in the same atomic commit as its carrier's producer report for the same work item.
symptom: Bound control packet 3fbf9bb4 stayed pending after its rebound carrier did the work and reported, and was released again on terminalize.
root_cause: The research producer-report commit path did not fold bound pending controls into an incorporated disposition, so consume-marking never fired for research carriers.

title: S0m — channel mail addressed to texture:* persists then silently drops
invariant: A durable addressed message must either reach a deliverable desk or be rejected at commit, never persisted as a silent dead letter.
symptom: A channel envelope addressed to texture:* committed durably and was then silently discarded by the actor handler while the sender's reduce succeeded.
root_cause: channelCast validates only the cast role, not target deliverability, and the actor handler returns unchanged memory for texture:* mailboxes.

title: S0m finding: "desk authors no act" is a contract split + mask, not agency
invariant: A desk turn-end trigger must label the act actually staged and must not consume a multi-cell turn before the demanded act is staged.
symptom: Texture desk cells ran and committed turns with no authoring act, so the probe's demanded bare choir.Ask never occurred.
root_cause: consumeIdleTextureTrigger mislabels any non-ApplyTexture cell as no authoring act, and the texture prompt contract forbids the bare Ask the probe demanded.

title: S0m finding: desk runs submit but never dispatch after guest reboot
invariant: Every run minted for a desk must carry a durable activation obligation that survives a dropped synchronous initial dispatch.
symptom: Desk runs minted as pending stayed pending indefinitely with running_runs at 0 after guest reboot.
root_cause: Runtime.activate dispatches initial_dispatch synchronously and only logs errors, and the only rescue watchdog is restricted to persistent Management runs.

title: S0m: directive packets cannot wake the engineering desk agent
invariant: Every directive addressed to a desk must be bound to an activation that consumes it, or be rejected at commit rather than left pending.
symptom: Directive packets addressed to engineering:<docID> stay pending forever because nothing binds them to a run.
root_cause: The engineering desk agent never runs, and the lifecycle reconcile branch only treats research agents as lifecycle agents.

title: S0m finding: freed control packet never rebinds — `delivered_at` invariant break on unbind
invariant: A pure unbind of a dead run's claim must return a control packet to the unclaimed pending state without stamping a delivery timestamp or charging a delivery attempt.
symptom: A freed control packet stayed pending with delivered_to_run_id null and no replacement carrier was minted for 8 minutes or more.
root_cause: The non-exhausted unbind branch of ReconcileUpdateDelivery re-stamps DeliveredAt and increments DeliveryAttempts, hiding the packet from the pending scan.

title: S0m finding: freed control re-strand — RESOLVED (TerminalizeRun clears ActiveRunID)
invariant: A terminal run must never remain recorded as an agent's ActiveRunID after it terminalizes, regardless of which termination path ended it.
symptom: After a carrier was cancelled, the freed control never rebound because the resolver found a dead ActiveRunID and returned ErrLifecycleInvalidTransition.
root_cause: The TerminalizeRun reducer never cleared agent.ActiveRunID; only projectLifecycleRun cleared it on activation terminalization.

title: Problem: in-guest runtime changes do not reach a constructed-computer-version guest via the host deploy
invariant: A guest runtime change must not count as proven until the guest's own reported commit matches the fix commit, not the host proxy commit.
symptom: Probes ran against a constructed guest still on 734ce69b while the host build was e824826a, so the earlier deployed proof was invalid.
root_cause: The CI global refresh skips constructed-computer-version computers and the host deploy does not move the guest executable pinned by its realization.

title: S0m finding: persistent-Management live-occurrence storm — substrate dispatch defect
invariant: Every pending obligation must on processing bind, discharge, or reach a bounded terminal fate, and must never loop a Management occurrence without changing obligation state.
symptom: After a VM refresh the staging API returned 502 for tens of minutes while Management live occurrences repeated across many trajectories and freed controls never rebound.
root_cause: Each occurrence rescans owner-wide pending history under serialized Dolt locks, and unbounded re-drive issuance lacks any convergence invariant.

title: S0m finding: post-boot desk-mint cells never dispatch — boot re-drive does not cover live mints
invariant: A lifecycle activation commit that hits a transient store deadline must be retried idempotently so a submitted desk-cell mint is never silently dropped.
symptom: Prompt-bar submissions during the post-boot backlog minted trajectories but never minted texture desk cells, returning 500 with context deadline exceeded.
root_cause: ReplaceLifecycleActivation's run-object write exceeded its deadline under post-boot outbox backlog, and the failed mint was not re-driven.

title: S0m blocker: prompt-bar submit fails — Dolt projection batch write cancelled under load
invariant: A prompt-bar commit must complete within a bounded write deadline with retry, never abort mid-transaction and leave no trajectory minted.
symptom: POST /api/prompt-bar hung past client timeouts while the server logged context canceled inside the projection batch, and no trajectory was minted.
root_cause: unknown

title: s0m: record-native producer report dies on desk-name ToDesk — 2026-10-02
invariant: A desk-name addressed producer report must resolve to its canonical agent id before authority resolution, and must never abort the commit for a documented addressing form.
symptom: Lifecycle-bound producer reports addressed by desk name such as texture failed authority resolution, so no report commitment was minted.
root_cause: resolveCoagentUpdateAuthorityWithStore expects an exact agent id, and the report path never applied the desk-name translation that directives use.

title: S0m: research desk cannot call choir.Report/ReportPacket — signature undocumented
invariant: Every verb a desk agent is instructed to call must have its exact Go signature stated in its overlay prompt.
symptom: Thirteen consecutive desk cells failed at compile time guessing choir.Report and ReportPacket signatures, and the answer was narrated instead of committed.
root_cause: The research and management overlays name the reporting verbs but never state their Go signatures, so the model invents wrong ones.

title: S0m — stranded-bound control packet deadlocks its target desk
invariant: A control packet bound to a dead run must be released and re-wakeable, never left bound and invisible to the pending scan.
symptom: Ten control packets stayed bound to completed research carriers, never rebound and never terminalized, on staging trajectory 0bdcbf61.
root_cause: Unbinding ran only inside the target desk's own activation path, which bound-invisible packets could never reach, so the stranded state was self-sustaining.

title: S1 remainder: autoputer gateway token rides the guest kernel cmdline
invariant: A per-VM gateway credential must never be delivered through a world-readable channel that guest child processes can read.
symptom: The autoputer gateway token was passed as a kernel cmdline parameter, which every guest process can read from world-readable /proc/cmdline.
root_cause: vmmanager appends choir.gateway_token to the Firecracker boot args in both the store-disk and legacy branches.

title: S1 remainder: guest runtime runs unconfined root; children share its UID and env
invariant: Guest runtime child processes must run under a UID and environment that cannot read the runtime's credentials or ptrace the runtime.
symptom: The autoputer runs as root and terminal and zot children inherit its UID and environment, so a same-UID child can read its token files.
root_cause: The go-choir-autoputer unit has no User= and terminal children are spawned with plain exec.Command under the same UID, so DAC cannot separate them.

title: S1a: guest route resolution 403s — the tap bind conflated the route slot's desktop with a computer ID
invariant: A route-slot authority bind must resolve ownership by the same owner and desktop identity the route slot is built from, never by a computer ID.
symptom: Every tap-sourced guest ResolveComputerVersionRoute call returned 403 caller not bound to route slot computer after the S1a boundary landed.
root_cause: The bind passed the route slot's desktop segment into a computer-keyed ownership lookup that could never match.

title: S2-g: app-layer push reaches targets only through narrow bind gates — 3 consecutive skipped-land deploys
invariant: An app-layer release push must mint offers that satisfy the signed-offer contract (head, verifier evidence, fresh realization, short expiry) so every eligible computer can land it.
symptom: Three consecutive app-layer deploys built and pushed a layered release but landed it on zero computers, reporting 0/0 healthy with N skipped.
root_cause: The CI offer mint omitted verifier evidence, used a stale realization epoch, and set a 30-minute expiry, each refused by an offer contract gate.

title: S2 finding: builder-substrate decision — privileged-builder-capsule is not a drop-in; host-service is the evidence-backed selection
invariant: App-layer closure builds must run where network and a writable store exist, not inside capsules that forbid both.
symptom: A privileged-builder-capsule cannot run nix build because capsules are network-isolated and force /nix/store read-only.
root_cause: Capsule namespaces apply NEWNET and a forced read-only /nix/store, and no resource tier relaxes either.

title: S2-g: CI had no app-layer push path — every runtime change rebooted guests
invariant: A binary-only platform change must reach live computers through an app-layer push that does not reboot them.
symptom: Every autoputer selection forced a boot-contract refresh that rebooted all mutable active interactive computers, even for binary-only changes.
root_cause: deploy-impact-classify forced mark_guest_boot_contract for every autoputer selection, and CI had no app-layer build, mint, or push phase.

title: Frontend-by-digest proof: what the tape and binaries already establish, and the one line still missing
invariant: A layered release must carry and serve its own built frontend, so served frontend bytes always derive from the release build.
symptom: A frontend-less layered release applied cleanly and then served HTTP 503 on / with served SPA is underivable.
root_cause: stageRelease copied only manifest files, so a release without an inline frontend/index.html staged no frontend directory.

title: Guest store head lags corpusd tape — layered apply permanently stale
invariant: The head a platform update binds must come from the same authority the apply gate compares against, so the guest projected head tracks the canonical head.
symptom: Five consecutive platform-update offers bound to corpusd's canonical head were refused as base event head is stale, with no effect accepted.
root_cause: Mint reads corpusd's canonical head while apply compares against the guest's local projected head, which lags events committed to corpusd outside replay.

title: S2: host-service builder substrate landed — closure + base-identity + evidence receipt
invariant: An app-layer closure must export exactly the base-absent delta, bound to the base image identity it resolves against.
symptom: Builder output has no updater-side consumer because ReleaseManifest cannot carry the closure and base-identity join.
root_cause: The release manifest decoders reject unknown fields and the Files representation cannot express a Nix store-path graph.

title: S2: a layered release cannot be transported — the signed offer carries payload bytes inline under a 64 MB cap
invariant: A signed platform-update offer must reference release payloads by content digest rather than inline bytes, so releases of any size transport under bounded request caps.
symptom: A real layered closure of about 146 MB, base64-encoded, exceeded the 64 MB body cap and the signed offer was rejected at mint.
root_cause: Signed offers carry payload bytes inline as base64, and the 64 MB cap is enforced at three hops.

title: S2-e: layering exec pointer is a global file outside the release dir — rollback does not revert exec
invariant: A release exec pointer must live inside its release directory and swap atomically with current, so rollback always reverts the executed binary.
symptom: After a health-failing layered apply restored current to the predecessor, the next service start re-exec'd the failed release binary and crash-looped.
root_cause: The layering entrypoint was a single global file outside releases/<digest> and outside the current swap, so restorePrior never reverted it.

title: S2: post-swap guest restart loop can kill Firecracker and cold-boot the disposable
invariant: A post-swap runtime that fails health must trip a bounded, host-readable guard so restart loops end without the host killing the VM.
symptom: A rollback re-apply put the guest into a roughly 9-minute restart loop, then Firecracker was killed and the VM cold-booted with a new boot id.
root_cause: unknown

title: S2: a refused apply wedges the pending transition — every later offer permanently stale
invariant: Every accepted platform-update transition must be discharged once its update is refused, so a pending transition never blocks later offers.
symptom: A refused signed offer left the pending transition open, so every later offer was refused as base event head is stale.
root_cause: ApplyPlatformUpdate discharged a failed transition only when a recovery receipt verified, but pre-mutation refusals return an empty result with no receipt.

title: S2-c: release provenance unbound — caller-supplied commit, no binary check
invariant: A release's declared code_commit must equal the commit embedded in its entrypoint binary before any pointer swap.
symptom: A hand-staged release with a synthetic code_commit could be minted as a real layered offer and activated.
root_cause: The builder accepted a caller-supplied CodeCommit and nothing checked it against the binary's embedded build identity.

title: S2-d: no pre-mutation state-compatibility gate — a stale binary can exec against a newer store
invariant: A release must be refused before any mutation when its binary's store-schema epoch is incompatible with the persisted guest store.
symptom: A stale hand-staged binary could exec against a newer persistent store because activation checked only image identity.
root_cause: Apply checked only the base image digest, and the guest store had no declared schema epoch the updater could read.

title: S2: applied releases never exec — runtime still runs the base-image binary
invariant: An applied release's entrypoint must be the process that runs after restart, falling back to base only when no release is pinned.
symptom: A self-dev apply swapped current and restarted the service, but the guest kept exec'ing the immutable base-image autoputer binary.
root_cause: autoputerRuntimeExec hard-execs the base image binary path, so a restart never runs the release binary.

title: S2-f: self-dev runtime changes binary-carried — no source patch reach the builder
invariant: Self-development runtime source changes must reach the builder as a verifiable source patch, never as binary-carried artifacts, for acceptance releases.
symptom: Self-dev workspace source edits were recorded in the bundle but never materialized for a builder, so only binary-carried runtime changes could ship.
root_cause: The capsule freeze staged only compiled binaries, and the effect contract had no way to request a source rebuild.

title: A stranded accepted event with a retired realization wedges the computer permanently
invariant: A pending platform-update transition whose bound realization can never match again must be discharged by the boot sweep, so it cannot block all later updates.
symptom: A computer refused every platform update as base event head is stale, indefinitely, after a stranded accepted event bound a retired realization.
root_cause: resumePendingPlatformUpdate logged the permanently inapplicable realization-bound offer and returned, leaving PendingTransitionRef set forever.

title: Updater daemon discards its refusal reason — layered-apply refusals are un-diagnosable
invariant: Every updater pre-mutation refusal must return its specific reason to the caller, so layered-apply refusals are attributable without guest console access.
symptom: POST /v1/apply returned a generic updater refused request for every pre-mutation refusal gate, making distinct refusals indistinguishable from outside the guest.
root_cause: The daemon computed a distinct message for each of eight refusal gates, but only the recovered path returned its reason to the caller.

title: Delegated-cast producer report poisons persistent-Management delivered-page listing — every subsequent activation dies at ~30s
invariant: One durable delivered packet that fails consumption validation must not fail the delivered-page listing for every later activation of the consuming run.
symptom: Every persistent-Management activation failed about 30s after binding with lifecycle invalid transition while listing delivered packets.
root_cause: The ProducerReport arm validated delegated-cast reports against the consumer's control bindings, a different ID space, and threw on the whole page.

title: Persistent Management mints a run that never starts and holds the slot forever
invariant: A persistent Management run that never receives its initial dispatch and has no bound packets must release the single slot so later occurrences can mint.
symptom: A freshly minted persistent Management run stayed pending for 27 minutes, holding the slot, so every later live occurrence deferred as slot occupied.
root_cause: The watchdog returned without releasing the slot when no bound packets existed; the initial_dispatch loss mechanism is hypothesized, not confirmed.

title: SA: projection base watermark never refreshed — recovery tail grows unbounded
invariant: Recovery work for any computer is bounded by MaxRecoveryTailEvents because its projection base watermark is refreshed as the canonical head advances.
symptom: A computer boot-looped refusing genesis fallback because its recovery tail was 423,720 events, far above the 10,000 cap.
root_cause: computer_replay_watermarks was written only by a manual choir-rebuild-base CLI, with no scheduled job re-publishing the base as the head advanced.

title: SA slice 1: wake-outbox re-arm storm — restart re-feeds the herd (owner guest)
invariant: Discharged or dead durable obligations must reach a recorded terminal fate, so a boot never re-arms the same wake backlog.
symptom: Every owner-guest boot re-minted about 2.1k pending wakes and re-dispatched dead wakes, starving genuine owner work behind the herd.
root_cause: The wake migration is idempotent per key but not convergent: disposing a dead wake leaves its source obligation pending, so the next boot re-arms it.

title: AppendEvent scans the whole event objectgraph per write — OOM at owner scale
invariant: Appending an event must cost independent of total event history, never scanning the whole event store per write.
symptom: AppendEvent lists up to 100k event objects twice per write, and a 31 GiB owner store ended in an out-of-memory kill of the guest.
root_cause: Seq and StreamSeq are derived by scanning all stored events instead of maintaining an O(1) persisted cursor.

title: Self-Development Operations Retry Silently No-Ops on Passivated Bound Super
invariant: A retry of a durable self-development operation must either wake its bound Super or return an explicit error, never a silent 200 no-op.
symptom: The retry POST returned 200 with the operation unchanged and no new Super run or 409, because the single bound run was passivated.
root_cause: selfDevelopmentSuperRunTerminal omits passivated, so a passivated bound run makes the wake branch return (operation, nil) indefinitely.

title: SMG probe on a fresh disposable: Texture desk burns the full token budget per run
invariant: A desk activation must end by emitting its control or hitting a bounded budget, never looping tool calls until the budget is exhausted.
symptom: Texture desk runs on a fresh disposable exhausted the 1.2M-token budget, later the 45-minute wall, without emitting a control, so the SMG legs failed.
root_cause: unknown

title: management-open 500: `replace durable activation: lifecycle invalid transition` on fresh disposable
invariant: Concurrent activations of the same agent must converge to one active run, with the losing submit returning the winner's run instead of erroring.
symptom: The first management-open call on a fresh disposable returned 500 with 'replace durable activation: lifecycle invalid transition'.
root_cause: A lifecycle wake from the sweep activated the Texture agent between StartLifecycle and EnsureTextureHandoff, so the second submit found an active previous run.
enforcer: submitTextureAgentRevisionRun / recoverRacedTextureActivation (package not named in doc)

title: Texture Audit Can Misreport Committed Mutations
invariant: A post-commit audit append failure must never change the external success result of an already-committed mutation.
symptom: Audit append failures returned HTTP 500 or tool errors after document or lifecycle mutations had committed, and retries could mint a second revision.
root_cause: Audit append errors were propagated as mutation failure, and event idempotency derived from command ID collided across owners sharing one computer.

title: Passivated Texture Revision Runs Make Boot Texture Recovery Ambiguously Refuse Startup
invariant: Boot recovery must select at most one live-eligible run per document and must never resume a passivated run as recovery authority.
symptom: Runtime startup was refused with 'ambiguous boot Texture recovery run authority', crash-looping roughly every 33 seconds.
root_cause: Boot candidate selection used !State.Terminal(), so multiple passivated revision runs for one document counted as live recovery candidates.

title: Texture desk activation contract: undelivered-update respawn loop and fatal write gate
invariant: Every pending desk update must reach a terminal disposition within a bounded redelivery budget, so no inbox item respawns the desk forever.
symptom: The Texture desk respawned about every 45 seconds across 33+ consecutive failed runs, committing almost no revisions.
root_cause: Updates stay pending when the desk's write path slips, and the run-fatal write gate plus reconcile-on-pending forms an unbounded respawn loop with no circuit breaker.

title: Texture desk burns a full activation failing to call `choir.ApplyTexture` — `undefined: choir` then invented packet fields
invariant: Every agent-facing verb must document its exact argument schema in the prompt and return decode errors that enumerate the valid fields.
symptom: A Texture desk activation spent about 49k input tokens failing on 'undefined: choir' and then 'unknown field type', with zero commits.
root_cause: The run_system prompt never names the packet fields or the required import, and the strict decode error lists no valid field set.

title: Texture desk `decide` rejects `decision_kind: "wait"` — run dies after verbatim retries
invariant: A deterministic validation rejection of an agent tool call must return the error for re-composition, never replay the identical arguments.
symptom: A decide turn with decision_kind 'wait' was rejected, and the required-write retry replayed the identical call until the run died.
root_cause: The enum accepts wait_for_evidence rather than wait, and the executor's required-write retry replays the same call under the same call_id.

title: Texture desk incorporate deadlocks when the producer work item already settled
invariant: An inbound update must be dispositionable as incorporated once its producer work item has settled, so no pending update can deadlock the desk.
symptom: Every incorporate of a completed engineering report failed with lifecycle invalid transition, and the desk respawned 33+ times.
root_cause: The reducer requires the producer work item to still be open, conflating open-to-settle with incorporability even though the assignment runtime already settled it.

title: Texture Latency — Layered Evidence & Research Map
invariant: Guest store reads must not queue behind whole-computer scans under the shared engine mutex.
symptom: Editor latency of 0.5 to 13 seconds, with engineMu held about 97% of wall time and every operation waiting about 1.1s on average.
root_cause: Hot reads are unindexed whole-computer or JSON-extract scans (ReadObjectSnapshot, ListObjectsByMetadata) that hold a single shared mutex.

title: Texture hollow revisions: research→Texture return path dead
invariant: Every completed research report addressed to a Texture desk must reach that desk's durable queue and wake it.
symptom: Thirteen revisions over about 19 hours were boilerplate 'research pending' text, while completed research results never reached revision content.
root_cause: Research choir.Message was dropped at the queue boundary for lacking ProducerUpdateID, channel mail was a no-op for Texture, and research had no typed report surface.

title: Texture list/revision reads flap during OOM — doc list loads, revision body fails
invariant: Under memory pressure a revision read must return its body or an explicit error, never present an existing revision as an empty v0.
symptom: Revision body fetches failed with context canceled and write timeouts while the document list loaded, so the editor showed a blank v0.
root_cause: Objectgraph reads are canceled inside the platform-dolt OOM and realization window, which the doc attributes to the store substrate rather than texture code.

title: Guest VM does not rebind :8085 after SIGKILL + vmctl resolve-restart
invariant: A restarted computer must not register as active until its guest serves :8085 and a recoverable projection base exists.
symptom: After SIGKILL and resolve-restart the guest autoputer never bound :8085 and fatals with 'required projection base is missing'.
root_cause: PlanRecovery refuses an existing chain with watermarkSeq==0 before checking whether the retained store can resume, and nothing publishes a verified base after genesis.

title: vmctl idle sweep hibernates a computer with in-flight runs
invariant: A computer with in-flight guest runs must never be hibernated by the idle sweep.
symptom: Computers were hibernated mid-desk-run about 31 minutes after start while their run tool loops were still issuing inference calls.
root_cause: CheckIdleOwnerships decides idleness only from the host-side LastActiveAt timestamp and never consults the guest's running_runs signal.

title: vmctl pressure reclaim hibernates a computer inside the desk respawn gap
invariant: A computer owed pending desk mutations must not be eligible for pressure hibernation.
symptom: A computer was hibernated with reason=pressure while its texture desk still owed an apply_owner_revision activation.
root_cause: guestBusy() checks only running_runs > 0, which reads zero in the gap between desk activations.

title: World Wire corpus: 99 GB store, 15-day CPU burn, dead processing pipeline
invariant: Source fetches must be bounded by downstream processing capacity, and corpus blobs must never be garbage-collected without a liveness check against the store that holds them.
symptom: A 99 GB corpus store with sustained CPU burn, while 208k processor requests were superseded and sourcecycled fetches piled up unprocessed.
root_cause: unknown for the CPU burn; the og GC liveness query reads the wrong store (Store A instead of Store B), so its 421k deletable-file figure is a wrong-store artifact.
